title: baliospermum calycinum var. siamense
intro: Baliospermum calycinum var. siamense, commonly known as the Siamese spineflower, is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. It is valued for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of B. calycinum var. siamense include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-cancer properties, and exhibit anti-platelet aggregation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
